verses.original: Ἐν δὲ ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις παραγίνεται Ἰωάννης ὁ βαπτιστὴς κηρύσσων ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τῆς Ἰουδαίας
verses.transliteration: En de tais hēmerais ekeinais paraginetai Iōannēs ho baptistēs kēryssōn en tē erēmō tēs Ioudaias
verses.literal: In those days John the Baptist came preaching in the wilderness of Judea
verses.literalPt: Naqueles dias, apareceu João Batista pregando no deserto da Judeia:

verses.original: καὶ λέγων Μετανοεῖτε ἤγγικεν γὰρ ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν
verses.transliteration: kai legōn Metanoeite ēngiken gar hē basileia tōn ouranōn
verses.literal: and saying Repent for the kingdom of heaven is near
verses.literalPt: Arrependei-vos, porque está próximo o reino dos céus.

verses.original: οὗτος γάρ ἐστιν ὁ ῥηθεὶς διὰ Ἠσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος Φωνὴ βοῶντος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ Ἑτοιμάσατε τὴν ὁδὸν Κυρίου εὐθείας ποιεῖτε τὰς τρίβους αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: houtos gar estin ho rhētheis dia Ēsaiou tou prophētou legontos Phōnē boōntos en tē erēmō Hetoimasate tēn hodon Kyriou eutheias poieite tas tribous autou
verses.literal: This is he who was spoken of through the prophet Isaiah A voice of one calling in the wilderness Prepare the way for the Lord make straight paths for Him
verses.literalPt: Pois é a João que se refere o que foi dito pelo profeta Isaías: Voz do que clama no deserto: Preparai o caminho do Senhor, endireitai as suas veredas.

verses.original: Αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ Ἰωάννης εἶχεν τὸ ἔνδυμα αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τριχῶν καμήλου καὶ ζώνην δερματίνην περὶ τὴν ὀσφὺν αὐτοῦ ἡ δὲ τροφὴ ἦν αὐτοῦ ἀκρίδες καὶ μέλι ἄγριον
verses.transliteration: Autos de ho Iōannēs eichen to endyma autou apo trichōn kamēlou kai zōnēn dermatinēn peri tēn osphyn autou hē de trophē ēn autou akrides kai meli agrion
verses.literal: John - wore - a garment of camel’s hair with a leather belt around his waist - His food was locusts and wild honey
verses.literalPt: Ora, o mesmo João usava uma veste de pelo de camelo e uma correia em volta da cintura; e alimentava-se de gafanhotos e mel silvestre.

verses.original: Τότε ἐξεπορεύετο πρὸς αὐτὸν Ἱεροσόλυμα καὶ πᾶσα ἡ Ἰουδαία καὶ πᾶσα ἡ περίχωρος τοῦ Ἰορδάνου
verses.transliteration: Tote exeporeueto pros auton Hierosolyma kai pasa hē Ioudaia kai pasa hē perichōros tou Iordanou
verses.literal: People went out to him from Jerusalem and all Judea and the whole region around the Jordan
verses.literalPt: Então, ia ter com ele o povo de Jerusalém, de toda a Judeia e de toda a circunvizinhança do Jordão;

verses.original: καὶ ἐβαπτίζοντο ἐν τῷ Ἰορδάνῃ ποταμῷ ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ἐξομολογούμενοι τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: kai ebaptizonto en tō Iordanē potamō hyp’ autou exomologoumenoi tas hamartias autōn
verses.literal: Confessing their sins they were baptized by him in the Jordan River
verses.literalPt: e eram por ele batizados no rio Jordão, confessando os seus pecados.

verses.original: Ἰδὼν δὲ πολλοὺς τῶν Φαρισαίων καὶ Σαδδουκαίων ἐρχομένους ἐπὶ τὸ βάπτισμα αὐτοῦ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Γεννήματα ἐχιδνῶν τίς ὑπέδειξεν ὑμῖν φυγεῖν ἀπὸ τῆς μελλούσης ὀργῆς
verses.transliteration: Idōn de pollous tōn Pharisaiōn kai Saddoukaiōn erchomenous epi to baptisma autou eipen autois Gennēmata echidnōn tis hypedeixen hymin phygein apo tēs mellousēs orgēs
verses.literal: But when John saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his place of baptism he said to them You brood of vipers who warned you to flee from the coming wrath
verses.literalPt: Mas, vendo João que muitos fariseus e saduceus vinham ao seu batismo, disse-lhes: Raça de víboras, quem vos recomendou que fugísseis da ira vindoura?

verses.original: ποιήσατε οὖν καρπὸν ἄξιον τῆς μετανοίας
verses.transliteration: poiēsate oun karpon axion tēs metanoias
verses.literal: Produce fruit then in keeping with repentance
verses.literalPt: Dai, pois, frutos dignos do vosso arrependimento

verses.original: καὶ μὴ δόξητε λέγειν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς Πατέρα ἔχομεν τὸν Ἀβραάμ λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι δύναται ὁ Θεὸς ἐκ τῶν λίθων τούτων ἐγεῖραι τέκνα τῷ Ἀβραάμ
verses.transliteration: kai mē doxēte legein en heautois Patera echomen ton Abraam legō gar hymin hoti dynatai ho Theos ek tōn lithōn toutōn egeirai tekna tō Abraam
verses.literal: And do not presume to say to yourselves We have Abraham as our father For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham
verses.literalPt: e não queirais dizer dentro de vós mesmos: Temos como pai a Abraão; porque vos declaro que destas pedras Deus pode suscitar filhos a Abraão.

verses.original: ἤδη δὲ ἡ ἀξίνη πρὸς τὴν ῥίζαν τῶν δένδρων κεῖται πᾶν οὖν δένδρον μὴ ποιοῦν καρπὸν καλὸν ἐκκόπτεται καὶ εἰς πῦρ βάλλεται
verses.transliteration: ēdē de hē axinē pros tēn rhizan tōn dendrōn keitai pan oun dendron mē poioun karpon kalon ekkoptetai kai eis pyr balletai
verses.literal: The axe lies ready at the root of the trees and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire
verses.literalPt: O machado já está posto à raiz das árvores; toda árvore, pois, que não dá bom fruto é cortada e lançada no fogo.

verses.original: Ἐγὼ μὲν ὑμᾶς βαπτίζω ἐν ὕδατι εἰς μετάνοιαν ὁ δὲ ὀπίσω μου ἐρχόμενος ἰσχυρότερός μού ἐστιν οὗ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἱκανὸς τὰ ὑποδήματα βαστάσαι αὐτὸς ὑμᾶς βαπτίσει ἐν Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ καὶ πυρί
verses.transliteration: Egō men hymas baptizō en hydati eis metanoian ho de opisō mou erchomenos ischyroteros mou estin hou ouk eimi hikanos ta hypodēmata bastasai autos hymas baptisei en Pneumati Hagiō kai pyri
verses.literal: I baptize you with water for repentance but after me will come One more powerful than I whose sandals I am not worthy to carry He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire
verses.literalPt: Eu, na verdade, vos batizo com água para o arrependimento; mas aquele que há de vir depois de mim é mais poderoso do que eu, e não sou digno de levar-lhe as sandálias; ele vos batizará com o Espírito Santo e com fogo.

verses.original: οὗ τὸ πτύον ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ διακαθαριεῖ τὴν ἅλωνα αὐτοῦ καὶ συνάξει τὸν σῖτον αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν ἀποθήκην τὸ δὲ ἄχυρον κατακαύσει πυρὶ ἀσβέστῳ
verses.transliteration: hou to ptyon en tē cheiri autou kai diakathariei tēn halōna autou kai synaxei ton siton autou eis tēn apothēkēn to de achyron katakausei pyri asbestō
verses.literal: His winnowing fork is in His hand to clear His threshing floor and to gather His wheat into the barn but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire
verses.literalPt: A sua pá, ele a tem na sua mão e limpará bem a sua eira; recolherá o seu trigo no celeiro, mas queimará a palha em fogo inextinguível.

verses.original: Τότε παραγίνεται ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰορδάνην πρὸς τὸν Ἰωάννην τοῦ βαπτισθῆναι ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Tote paraginetai ho Iēsous apo tēs Galilaias epi ton Iordanēn pros ton Iōannēn tou baptisthēnai hyp’ autou
verses.literal: At that time Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan - - to be baptized by John
verses.literalPt: Depois, veio Jesus da Galileia ao Jordão ter com João, para ser batizado por ele.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Ἰωάννης διεκώλυεν αὐτὸν λέγων Ἐγὼ χρείαν ἔχω ὑπὸ σοῦ βαπτισθῆναι καὶ σὺ ἔρχῃ πρός με
verses.transliteration: ho de Iōannēs diekōlyen auton legōn Egō chreian echō hypo sou baptisthēnai kai sy erchē pros me
verses.literal: But John tried to prevent Him saying I need to be baptized by You and do You come to me
verses.literalPt: Mas João objetava-lhe: Eu é que preciso ser batizado por ti, e tu vens a mim?

verses.original: Ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν Ἄφες ἄρτι οὕτως γὰρ πρέπον ἐστὶν ἡμῖν πληρῶσαι πᾶσαν δικαιοσύνην τότε ἀφίησιν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Apokritheis de ho Iēsous eipen pros auton Aphes arti houtōs gar prepon estin hēmin plērōsai pasan dikaiosynēn tote aphiēsin auton
verses.literal: Let it be so now - Jesus replied . . . . . . . . . It is fitting for us to fulfill all righteousness in this way Then John permitted Him
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Deixa por agora, porque assim nos convém cumprir toda a justiça. Então ele anuiu.

verses.original: Βαπτισθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εὐθὺς ἀνέβη ἀπὸ τοῦ ὕδατος καὶ ἰδοὺ ἠνεῴχθησαν οἱ οὐρανοί καὶ εἶδεν τὸ Πνεῦμα τοῦ Θεοῦ καταβαῖνον ὡσεὶ περιστερὰν καὶ ἐρχόμενον ἐπ’ αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Baptistheis de ho Iēsous euthys anebē apo tou hydatos kai idou ēneōchthēsan hoi ouranoi kai eiden to Pneuma tou Theou katabainon hōsei peristeran kai erchomenon ep’ auton
verses.literal: As soon as . . . Jesus was baptized He went up out of the water Suddenly the heavens were opened and He saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and resting on Him
verses.literalPt: Batizado que foi Jesus, saiu logo da água; eis que se abriram os céus, e veio o Espírito de Deus descer como pomba e vir sobre ele; e uma voz dos céus disse:

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ φωνὴ ἐκ τῶν οὐρανῶν λέγουσα Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός ἐν ᾧ εὐδόκησα
verses.transliteration: kai idou phōnē ek tōn ouranōn legousa Houtos estin ho Huios mou ho agapētos en hō eudokēsa
verses.literal: And a voice from heaven said This is My beloved Son in whom I am well pleased
verses.literalPt: Este é o meu Filho dileto, em quem me agrado.
